title: setup: Invitations grid nests <a> inside <a>, Invite User gives no success feedback, and param dialogs share a generic subtitle
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Setup → Users → *Invite User* → Confirm, then Setup → Invitations.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- The invitation is created (`sys_invitation` pending, `sys_email` sent), but the dialog closes with no success message.
- The Invitations grid logs React's "In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a>. This will cause a hydration error." — an anchor nested inside the row/cell link.
- Action-parameter dialogs share one subtitle, "Please provide the required information to continue." (Invite User, Approve), instead of saying what the action does (e.g. that an email will be sent).

## Expected

A toast naming the invitee; valid DOM in the grid; a dialog description per action (from the action's own description when present).

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Show the action's `successMessage` or a default toast after param actions; render nested links as non-anchor elements; use the action description as the dialog subtitle.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
